It would be nice for the purposes of constructing A-Lists to have the 
backquote macro expand

	`(FROB1 ,@ FROB2) go to (CONS 'FROB1 FROB2)

instead of (APPEND (NCONS FROB1) FROB2) which will die. Indeed maybe 
`(FROB1 FROB2 ... FROBN-1 ,@ FROBN) should expand into cons's since they
are well defined in meaning even for atoms.

				--kmp
